verified_subject_count_basis: v1.0.2 summary.subjects lists 39 ids and the tree has 39 sub-* directories: NIH1-NIH11 (11), pt1-pt3 (3), PY18N*/PY19N* (8), jh103, jh105 (2), umf001-umf005 (5), rns002/003/004/005/006/009/011/013/014/015 (10). participants.tsv NOT opened (sealed); its row count is not used.

verified_modalities.ieeg: verified_present, interictal only: 54 EDF runs; session label 'extraoperative'; tasks interictal / interictalasleep / interictalawake; no ictal task. Channel types: rns* all SEEG; NIH*, PY* SEEG; jh*, pt*, umf001-003/005 ECOG; umf004 SEEG
verified_modalities.electrode_localisation: reported_absent: 0 electrodes.tsv and 0 coordsystem.json in snapshot 1.0.2; only channel names (e.g. LTP, LAM, LHH in sub-rns002) are available
verified_modalities.anatomical_mri_ct_dwi: reported_absent: no anat/dwi/CT in snapshot tree
verified_modalities.seizure_annotations: No ictal recordings. Clinician channel labels verified in channels.tsv: 'soz' column present with >=1 'yes' in 39/39 subjects; 'epz' column in a subset; channels.json defines RZ (resected zone, 'estimated region'), EPZ (early propagation zone), SOZ (seizure onset zone). events.tsv holds clip/annotation notes only

intervention_linkage.basis: v1.0.2 README ('Some subjects, namely with the rns prefix in their subject ID were treated with RNS rather then surgical resection/ablation') + per-run channels.tsv/channels.json columns inspected for all 54 runs. participants.tsv and sourcedata xlsx not used.

by_subject_group.RNS-treated (README): sub-rns002, rns003: intervention = responsive neurostimulation (README). channels.tsv has NO 'rz' column in 10/10 (consistent with no resection); 'soz' column with 'yes' channels in 10/10; 'epz' column in 8/10 (absent rns002, rns003). Recordings are pre-implant extraoperative interictal SEEG (128 channels in 9/10, 46 in rns009). Centre not stated per subject in README -> to_verify
by_subject_group.Resection/ablation (README default for n: contact-level 'rz' (clinician-marked resected zone, described in channels.json as 'the estimated region; for rigorous annotation, utilize the post-surgical MRI') present with >=1 'yes' channel in 23/29; absent (no rz column) in 6/29: PY18N007, PY18N015, PY19N012, PY19N015, PY19N023, PY19N026. Resection vs ablation per subject not distinguished in sidecars

intervention_linkage.correction: A0036 relayed Omni-iEEG has_resection=1 for all 39 subjects; this is contradicted by the README for the 10 rns* subjects. Do not use Omni-iEEG has_resection for these ids.

stimulation_information.rns_device_settings: reported_absent: no stimulation amplitude, pulse width, frequency, burst duration, charge density or therapy schedule in README, dataset_description, participants.json, channels.tsv/json, ieeg.json (Manufacturer 'n/a'), events.tsv or scans.tsv/json
stimulation_information.rns_lead_locations: reported_absent: no lead/contact designation for the implanted RNS device and no electrode coordinates; channels.tsv describes the diagnostic SEEG implant only
stimulation_information.detection_parameters: reported_absent: no detection settings, long-episode/saturation counts or device-recorded ECoG
stimulation_information.post_implant_recordings: reported_absent: only the pre-implant 'extraoperative' session exists
stimulation_information.derivatives: derivatives contain source-sink indices and HFO rates for ids sub-002..sub-015 (numbering matches rns ids; mapping to sub-rnsNNN inferred, not stated) plus unshared-site ids (la*, nl*, upmc*, pt4-pt13) - no stimulation fields
stimulation_information.unopened_possible_source: sourcedata/ieeg_database_all.xlsx (58 KB) may contain clinical columns; it was not opened because clinical/outcome spreadsheets are sealed for this study. Whether it holds RNS lead/target information is to_verify by an authorized vault/column-level review

outcome_fields_present: Per participants.json (dictionary only): outcome (S/F/NR, described as 'after surgery'), engel_score (1-4, -1 = no surgery or outcome), ilae_score (1-6, -1), years_follow_up, site. Values are in participants.tsv, SEALED; no outcome values or counts are reported here. How RNS-treated subjects are coded (e.g. NR or -1 vs a post-RNS Engel class) is unknown -> to_verify via vault.
follow_up_definition: participants.json: years_follow_up = 'The number of years of follow up since the surgery.' Per-patient values sealed -> to_verify; for RNS subjects the reference date (implant vs other) is not defined
eligibility: Resection arm: low fit (interictal only, no coordinates, clinician-estimated RZ in 23/29). Stimulation arm: the 10 rns* subjects give a verified treatment-modality label (RNS) plus pre-implant interictal SEEG with clinician SOZ/EPZ channel labels, but no RNS settings, lead locations, detection/stimulation parameters, coordinates or post-implant data. Usable at most as a weak label-level RNS group (e.g. SOZ-channel sets as an unverified proxy for stimulation targets), conditional on vault confirmation that post-RNS outcome labels exist with adequate follow-up; not usable to validate stimulation parameters or target geometry.
cohort_overlap: README: NIH pt1, pt2, pt3 and JHH jh103, jh105 are also in ds003029 (pt1=pt01, pt2, pt3, jh103, jh105) where ictal snapshots are stored (fam-jhu-sarma-multicenter, A0035). Present in Omni-iEEG as sub-sourcesink* (A0040) - not independent.
changes_vs_superseded: Supersedes A0036: intervention_linkage now per subject group from README + sidecars (10 RNS / 29 resection-ablation); Omni has_resection relay removed; stimulation information itemised; participants.tsv-derived site counts, follow-up strings and 51-row count removed (sealed source); size basis tied to snapshot 1.0.2.
